lineage: Copyright headers name Bootlin (2019) and Max Schettler (2023); descended from the libva-v4l2 work, not written from nothing.

ourTarget.gpu: Adreno 740, measured as ANGLE (freedreno, FD740, OpenGL 4.6)

upstreamClaims.h264: hardware decode, zero-copy import, frame MD5 equal to the native V4L2 decoder
upstreamClaims.hevcMain: hardware decode, zero-copy import, Fluster JCT-VC-HEVC_V1 111/147 (firmware 112)
upstreamClaims.hevcMain10: hardware decode, zero-copy import, MD5 equal at 10-bit
upstreamClaims.av1: not advertised, opt-in only; VA clients time out on hidden frames
upstreamClaims.verificationStatus: self-reported by the upstream author; no independent validation, 0 stars, single author, created 2026-09-22

installStrategy: No host image modification and no rpm-ostree layering. The module is built in a throwaway Fedora container and loaded through LIBVA_DRIVERS_PATH, so the experiment is removed by deleting one directory.
